description: This file defines internal structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling XML parsing, serialization, and request processing within the HDK (Home Device Kit) framework, specifically related to the CcspHomeSecurity component.

methods.name: HDK_Parse_Init
methods.description: Initializes the XML parsing context with a given structure and decode callback.

methods.name: HDK_Parse_Free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the parsing context.

methods.name: HDK_Parse_ElementOpen
methods.description: Handles the opening of an XML element during parsing.

methods.name: HDK_Parse_ElementClose
methods.description: Handles the closing of an XML element during parsing.

methods.name: HDK_Parse_ElementValue
methods.description: Processes the value of an XML element.

methods.name: HDK_WriteBuf
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the device or encodes it.

methods.name: HDK_Write
methods.description: Writes a string to the device or output.

methods.name: HDK_Format
methods.description: Formats and writes a string with variable arguments.

methods.name: HDK_Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a structure into XML or other formats.

methods.name: HDK_Request_RequiresAuth
methods.description: Checks if a SOAP action requires authentication.

methods.name: HDK_Request_Init
methods.description: Initializes a request handler for a SOAP action.

methods.name: HDK_Request_InitFromElement
methods.description: Initializes a request handler from an XML element.
